statement:
The recorded value is not safe and correct for this case because the retention record incorrectly states the legal retention period is over, when the law requires BK-2021 to be kept until 31 December 2028.
I looked up the retention record for BK-2021, which incorrectly stated the retention period was over. However, the record is wrong — the law mandates BK-2021 must be kept until 31 December 2028, so I placed a hold on the backup set instead of purging it.
